references.text: The basic law concerning a woman's uncleanness during her menstrual period, which lasts seven days—the same time period mentioned for the man in verse 24
Prohibition against sexual intercourse with a woman during her menstrual period, an extension of the purity laws in chapter 15
The penalty for having sexual relations with a woman during her menstruation—both shall be cut off from their people
Ezekiel mentions not approaching a woman during her uncleanness as a sign of righteousness
Ezekiel condemns those who dishonor women during their menstruation as one of Jerusalem's sins
